method: ElevenLabs Scribe v1 on the take uploaded as a plain audio asset (no access to the prompt text)
reference: Researchers asked three popular chatbots one simple question: What was the title of Adam Kalai's dissertation? Three polished answers. Not one had the right title… or even the right year. A language model writes in tokens: chunks of text. Some are whole words. Some are fragments. Each token is really a number. And at every step, the model scores every possible next token.
